cluster_label_0: Feature Requests (Minor) — dark mode and small UX polish asks from otherwise satisfied users (avg rating 4.2)
cluster_label_1: Wearable Sync — Positive — users praising smooth smartwatch/heart-rate syncing and subscription value (avg rating 3.9)
cluster_label_2: Pricing Perception — Favorable — users comparing the subscription favorably to a gym membership (avg rating 3.6)
cluster_label_3: Stability — Positive — users explicitly noting the app runs smoothly with no complaints (avg rating 3.9)
cluster_label_4: General Dissatisfaction: Value, Missing Features & Data Loss — a broad negative catch-all spanning pricing complaints, missing export/customization features, and lost workout data (avg rating 2.44, largest negative cluster at 27% of reviews). This cluster is heterogeneous enough that a second-pass sub-clustering (or LLM-based re-classification of just this cluster) would likely split it into 2-3 more actionable sub-themes.
cluster_label_5: Support Experience — Resolved — billing/account issues that were successfully resolved by support, generally positive despite starting as a complaint (avg rating 3.4)
cluster_label_6: Onboarding & Customer Service — Positive — new users praising ease of setup and helpful, patient support interactions (avg rating 3.8)
cluster_label_7: App Stability Crisis — Crashes & Broken Updates — the most severe negative cluster: crashing on workout start, force-closes, and app instability tied to a recent update (avg rating 2.28, 23% of all reviews, and the cluster whose volume share nearly doubled during Jul-Aug 2025).
digest_2025_07:
**Voice-of-Customer Weekly Digest — Week of Jul 7, 2025**

Average rating has dropped sharply to 2.5 (down from a 3.3-3.5 baseline), driven almost entirely by a spike in the 'App Stability Crisis' cluster, whose share of incoming reviews jumped from ~14% in June to over 34% this week. Representative quotes: "The app crashes every single time I try to start a workout," and "Since the July update the app is basically broken, crashes constantly." Wearable-sync complaints are also elevated. Recommend prioritizing a stability hotfix for the July release immediately -- this is a review-volume-and-severity pattern consistent with a shipped regression, not normal noise.
digest_2025_09:
**Voice-of-Customer Weekly Digest — Week of Sep 1, 2025**

Average rating has recovered to 3.35, back in line with the pre-incident baseline, and the 'App Stability Crisis' cluster's share of reviews has fallen back to ~19%, roughly its historical norm. This is consistent with the stability issues from the July release having been patched. Recommend a brief post-mortem to capture what testing gap let the regression ship, and continued monitoring of the crash-cluster share as an early-warning KPI rather than waiting for the next star-rating dip to notice a problem.
